thesis: Profit and backlog establish progress, but diluted per-share and cash returns are unresolved. Neither side supplies enough to adjudicate fair value at the growth multiple.
strongest_counterexample: Attributable profit rose 19.8% and RM2.37bn unbilled orders support execution visibility.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of declining year-on-year diluted EPS.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of positive diluted EPS growth and FCF/net income above 0.8.
evidence_gaps: Diluted share counts, dated EPS forecasts and project receivable aging.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Project backlog and attributable profit growth substantiate solar demand
The orderbook and attributable-profit growth establish demand and execution progress
